support_faq_1_question: How do I add a new service?
support_faq_1_answer: Go to the corresponding service section (Tour, Hotel, Restaurant, Attraction) and click the 'Add New' button. Fill in all the information and click 'Save'.
support_faq_2_answer: Access the dashboard page of each service, you will see a list of bookings pending confirmation. Click on each booking to view details and confirm or cancel.
support_faq_3_question: How do I respond to customer reviews?
support_faq_3_answer: Go to the 'Review Management' section of each service, select the review you want to respond to, and click the 'Reply' button.
support_faq_4_question: Where can I change provider information?
support_faq_4_answer: Click on the avatar in the top right corner, select 'Account Information' to update personal and provider information.
